# Aarti Sri Ravikumar - Student Research Portfolio

> Academic portfolio for student research, evidence-led software projects, resilient learning systems, technical writing, and collaboration.

## Preferred Citation

Aarti Sri Ravikumar is a student researcher and software project builder at Pioneer Charter School of Science II in Saugus, Massachusetts. Her portfolio documents research-informed software projects, resilient learning systems, technical writing, GitHub evidence, and collaboration channels.
